parameters.name: handlingUnit
parameters.description: EACH, CASE or PALLET. Resolves the standard that applies to this handling unit (the unit's own standard, else the task-type-only one). Absent or empty means the task-type-only standard.

schema.description: The packaging level a standard is declared for, and that a completed task handled (ADR 0035). INNER is deliberately absent: no flow implements it in v1.
schema.title: HandlingUnit
